methodology.itemMean: sum(score * response_count) / sum(response_count); sum counts across evaluations first
methodology.total: sum available male/female item counts, then recompute mean; no imputation
methodology.summary: all-item response-weighted mean, not a learning-domain or satisfaction-only measure
methodology.studentCount: not identifiable; respondents is null; responses are answers to ONE item
methodology.courseIdentity: exact source course name (NFC and whitespace only) within degree/specialty/year/semester; no guessed code
methodology.duplicatePolicy: remove identical repeated items only if the evaluation has no conflicting repeated items; quarantine entire evaluation on any conflict
methodology.missingPolicy: missing cohorts stay null; partial item counts/means stay null; knownResponseCounts retain accepted observed counts
methodology.itemCoverage: expected items are source topic/number identities for the observed instrument(s) in each year/semester; missing items flag partial coverage; different instruments remain distinct
methodology.privacy: only course aggregates; no lecturer names, numbers, individual results or private identity hashes
